notes.title: "The Mending" NAME CHANGE ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
Hello all!

After much consideration, "The Mending" has been officially renamed to "Sinner's Ridge".  The title better reflects the genre, story and overall themes of the game, rather than a vague, unusual and unrelatable title that was originally intended for the shorter introduction of this project.

Another thing of note is that the art direction has changed.  Originally the project relied on post-processing effects and shaders to create a "toon" style visual effect for the game.  The goal of the project is to produce a game that essentially takes Silent Hill and Borderlands and merge them into one unique survival-horror experience.  Now, the models will be more of a toon and low poly style to aid with the post-processing to give the full effect of the mood and visuals we are trying to achieve.  More can be seen from updated screenshots as the alpha demo continues along towards release.

Tyler
Black Knife Games

notes.title: The Mending World Premiere at Horror Game Awards
notes.notes:
If you missed the HGA this past saturday, you can watch the recap, see all of the exclusive trailers showcased, and the winners of each award on their YouTube channel.  It was a pleasure to be a part of this event and to reveal the all new cinematic teaser for The Mending!

I have seen a tremendous influx of wishlists since the event, and makes me happy that people seem interested in what I am cooking up!  I can't wait to share more.

Be sure to wishlist The Mending!

If you want to be an early beta-tester of demos, sign up on our website here: https://blackknifegames.com/

notes.title: Under development into a larger project!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

As the current trailer says, the game was originally slated to be released this past Halloween.  This game was to serve as an introduction to a much larger project that was planned, however, it will now instead just be the larger project, and a free demo will be released sometime in January 2024!  I plan on the full game coming out around this time next year.

I hope this will give you some excitement for the full-scale project, with 4-5 hours of content and replay ability features.

Stay in the loop by joining up on my [url=https://blackknifegames.com/subscribe]website[/url].

It will also give you early access to the demo when it is ready, and access to the discord where you can share feedback!

Thanks for wishlisting!  More updates to come, including an updated trailer and screenshots.
